title: 第四章 晕船
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“时候也不早了，大家都先上船吧。”

“二位先生，你们也都早先回去吧，”

“再见。”

“再见。”

这一批考生有四五十个人，大家都是分批上船。

包国维是有过目不忘的能力，上辈子只要看过的事情都记得，但一期学员好几百个人，包国维熟悉的人的名字也就那么一些。

这一批上船的人，名字最深刻的就是第一名的蒋羡耘，还有打仗是外行的黄惟，另一个就是徐翔谦。至于其他一些人的名字对包国维来讲有些陌生了。

不过大家上船之后，就开始互相介绍熟络起来。

蒋羡耘是第一名，学识渊博，为人和善，乐于助人，大家也都愿意同他交流。

包国维也过去和他打了个招呼：“羡耘大哥，我是浙江考生包国维，这一路还望互相帮助。”

“这是自然，在码头时先生就说了，我们这一批考生理应互相关心互相照顾守望相助。国维同学你好，我是湖南考生蒋羡耘。”

第一名主动伸出了手，和包国维握了一下。

“国维，看你年龄应该不大。”

包国维光看长相的话，其实看着也不算小，但确实稚嫩了点，认真瞧的话会瞧出年龄来：“十六岁。”

“十六岁，真是年轻。我二十二，可是长了你六岁了。倒也是担得起你这么一句羡耘大哥。”

交浅言深，虽然初识，包国维同他聊了不少。上海出发去广州，这一路上打交道的机会不少。

又去和其他一些人认识了下。

“浙江包国维。”

“江西黄惟。”

十六岁，包国维可以说是这一批年龄最小的一个。但在同期中并不是最小的，还有十五岁的呢。

因为年龄小，跟谁都称呼一声大哥：“黄惟大哥，在考场的时候，我前面那个人也是江西考生叫方志鸣，成绩优异受考官看重。

他怎么没和我们一同出发。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"It's not too early, everyone should get on the boat first."

"Two gentlemen, you should all go back early,"

"Goodbye."

"Goodbye."

There were forty or fifty candidates in this batch, and everyone boarded the boat in batches.

Bao Guowei has a photographic memory and can remember everything he has seen in his previous life. However, there are hundreds of students in the first batch, and the names of the people Bao Guowei is familiar with are only so many.

Among the people who boarded the ship, the one with the most profound names was Jiang Xianyun, who was ranked first, Huang Wei, who was an outsider in fighting, and the other one was Xu Xiangqian.As for the names of some other people, they were a bit unfamiliar to Bao Guowei.

But after everyone got on the boat, they started to introduce each other and get to know each other.

Jiang Xianyun is the first, knowledgeable, kind and helpful, and everyone is willing to communicate with him.

Bao Guowei also went over to say hello to him: "Brother Xianyun, I am Bao Guowei, a candidate from Zhejiang. We hope to help each other along the way."

"It's natural. My husband said it when we were at the dock. Our group of candidates should care for each other and help each other. Hello, student Guowei, I am Jiang Xianyun, a candidate from Hunan."

The first person reached out his hand and shook Bao Guowei's hand.

"Guowei, judging from your age, you should be young."

Based on his appearance, Bao Guowei actually doesn't look too young, but he does look a bit immature. If you look carefully, you can tell his age: "Sixteen years old."

"Sixteen is really young. I'm twenty-two, but I'm six years older than you. I can afford to be such an envious big brother from you."

Although they had just met each other for the first time, Bao Guowei had a lot of chats with him.Setting off from Shanghai to Guangzhou, there were many opportunities to make contacts along the way.

Went to meet some other people.

"Zhejiang Bao Guowei."

"Jiangxi Huang Wei."

At sixteen years old, Bao Guowei can be said to be the youngest of this group.But he is not the youngest in the same period, there is also one who is fifteen years old.

Because of his young age, he called everyone "big brother": "Brother Huang Wei, when I was in the examination room, the person in front of me was also a Jiangxi candidate named Fang Zhiming. He had excellent grades and was valued by the examiner.

Why didn't he set off with us?"
